objective: Al terminar participas en una discusión de grupo: aportas ideas, reaccionas a otras, mantienes el turno y llegas a una conclusión conjunta.

warmup.prompt_es: En una discusión de grupo no solo cuenta lo que dices, sino cómo escuchas, reaccionas y construyes sobre lo que dicen otros. Es una habilidad clave en exámenes y en el trabajo.

lines.speaker: Moderator
lines.text: Today's topic: should schools make mindfulness part of the daily timetable? Anna, would you like to start?
lines.es: El tema de hoy: ¿deberían los colegios incluir mindfulness en el horario diario? Anna, ¿quieres empezar?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Thanks. I think it's a great idea. Studies suggest that regular practice reduces stress and improves concentration, which is exactly what students need.
lines.es: Gracias. Creo que es una gran idea. Los estudios sugieren que la práctica regular reduce el estrés y mejora la concentración, que es justo lo que necesitan los estudiantes.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I see your point, Anna, but I'm not so sure. The timetable is already crowded. If we add mindfulness, something else has to go. Which subject would you cut?
lines.es: Entiendo tu punto, Anna, pero no estoy tan seguro. El horario ya está lleno. Si añadimos mindfulness, algo tiene que salir. ¿Qué asignatura recortarías?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: That's a fair question. It wouldn't have to be a full lesson; ten minutes at the start of the day would be enough.
lines.es: Es una pregunta justa. No tendría que ser una clase completa; diez minutos al empezar el día serían suficientes.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.text: Building on what Anna said, ten minutes is realistic. In my school we tried it, and teachers noticed that pupils were calmer after break.
lines.es: Siguiendo con lo que dijo Anna, diez minutos es realista. En mi colegio lo probamos y los profesores notaron que los alumnos estaban más tranquilos después del recreo.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That's interesting. Though, to play devil's advocate, wouldn't some parents object? Some might see it as religious.
lines.es: Es interesante. Aunque, por hacer de abogado del diablo, ¿no se opondrían algunos padres? Algunos podrían verlo como algo religioso.

lines.speaker: Moderator
lines.text: Good point. Anna, how would you respond?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: It could be presented as a secular technique, based on breathing and attention. Schools could also offer an opt-out.
lines.es: Podría presentarse como una técnica laica, basada en la respiración y la atención. Los colegios también podrían ofrecer una opción de no participar.

lines.speaker: Clara
lines.text: I agree, and perhaps we could start with a pilot scheme before making it compulsory.
lines.es: Estoy de acuerdo, y quizá podríamos empezar con un programa piloto antes de hacerlo obligatorio.

lines.speaker: Moderator
lines.text: So, to sum up: we all agree it's worth trying, as long as it is short, voluntary at first and carefully evaluated. Thank you all.
lines.es: En resumen: todos coincidimos en que vale la pena probarlo, siempre que sea breve, voluntario al principio y evaluado con cuidado. Gracias a todos.

md_es: **Participar en una discusión de grupo**
| Función | Frases |
| **Empezar** | *I think … · In my opinion … · To my mind … · As I see it …* |
| **Mostrar acuerdo** | *I completely agree. · That's a good point. · I'd go along with that. · Exactly.* |
| **Acuerdo parcial** | *I see your point, but … · That's true up to a point, but … · I agree to some extent, however …* |
| **Desacuerdo educado** | *I'm not so sure. · I'm afraid I see it differently. · I'm not convinced that …* |
| **Construir sobre lo dicho** | *Building on what … said, … · Adding to that, … · To follow up on that, …* |
| **Abogado del diablo** | *To play devil's advocate, … · What if …? · Wouldn't some people say …?* |
| **Pedir opinión** | *What do you think, … ? · How would you respond? · Do you have anything to add?* |
| **Mantener el turno** | *Let me finish my point. · As I was saying, … · Just one more thing …* |
| **Concluir** | *To sum up, … · So we all agree that … · The general feeling seems to be that …* |
**Lenguaje de condición y compromiso**
- *as long as · provided that · on condition that · unless · so long as*: *It's worth trying as long as it's voluntary.*
- *We could start with …, then see how it goes.*
**Hedging (suavizar)**
- *It seems to me that … · I'd say that … · It could be argued that … · Perhaps we should …*
**Escuchar bien (en inglés también se evalúa)**
- Responde a lo que dijo el otro. · Usa su nombre: *As Ben said …* · No interrumpas: *Sorry, may I add something?* · Resume: *So you're saying that …?*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I am agree.* → ✔ *I agree.*
- ✘ *In my opinion, I think that …* (redundante) → ✔ *In my opinion, …* / *I think that …*
- ✘ *I'm not agree with you.* → ✔ *I don't agree with you.*
- ✘ *According to me* → ✔ *In my opinion* / *To my mind.*
**Ojo:** *According to* se usa con **otra** persona o fuente, no con uno mismo: ✘ *According to me* → ✔ *In my opinion.*
Pronunciación: *compulsory* /kəmˈpʌlsəri/ · *secular* /ˈsekjələ/ · *advocate* (sust.) /ˈædvəkət/.

self_check_es: ¿Incluyes una concesión (I see your point, but…)?
exercises.model_answer: I think schools should start later in the morning, because teenagers need more sleep to concentrate. I see the opposing view, but I'm not convinced that it would cause serious problems for families. To some extent, parents who work early might struggle, however schools could offer a breakfast club. Building on that, a later start would only work as long as the day ends at a reasonable time. To sum up, I believe it is worth trying, provided the results are evaluated after a year.
